moved.description: z distance a replay must push a row by to be an anomaly.

hold.description: Rows a flag must persist before it counts as an alarm, one count per value.

thresholds.description: The directory the thresholds came from.

onnx_files.description: The ONNX files the models scored as, as the thresholds record them. Null when the models scored in torch.

models.description: The directory the weights came from.

attack_set.description: The attack set the rows came from.

log_split.description: The log split the attack set was drawn on.

grid.description: The grid the split was cut from.

min_speed.description: The speed a row had to exceed to be counted.

rows.description: How many attacked rows were read.

attacks.description: How many attacks were injected into the test logs.

attacks_scorable.description: How many of them reach a row above `min_speed` and moved it by at least `moved`.

hours.description: Hours of rows above `min_speed` with no attack in them, what the false alarms are counted over.

versions.description: Python, NumPy, the platform, and torch or ONNX Runtime, whichever scored.
